annual_period_end_definition: December 31 of the labelled Gregorian observation year
cpi_semantic_compatibility_requirement: FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG must remain an annual CPI inflation-RATE series in percent in the selected archive vintage. An index-level, GDP-deflator or otherwise differently defined inflation series is a semantic mismatch.
frozen_project_prediction_cutoff: The earliest verified available_at timestamp of the predictor-year financial statement for each t -> t+1 pair.
fx_pair_compatibility_verification_requi: E_y and E_(y-1) use identical currency denomination
E_y and E_(y-1) use identical local-currency valuation convention
no currency-unit break or redenomination exists across the pair
E_y and E_(y-1) belong to the same archive vintage
fx_same_vintage_rule: Both annual exchange-rate levels used in the log change must come from the same selected vintage.

observation_year_operational_definition: selected_vintage = latest official WDI archive release with release_available_at < pair_cutoff
y = max {year: FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG[year] is non-missing in selected_vintage and Dec-31(year) < pair_cutoff}
If the set is empty, return null.
Do not use fiscal year as a direct year lookup.
Do not use an observation whose annual period has not finished before cutoff.
cand_m3i_cpi_inflation_annual.observation_year_selection_rule: Within the selected pre-cutoff WDI archive vintage, choose the maximum Gregorian observation year y for which FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG[y] is non-missing and December 31 of y is strictly earlier than the pair prediction cutoff.

observation_year_operational_definition: selected_vintage = latest official WDI archive release with release_available_at < pair_cutoff
eligible y requires every condition in observation_year_eligibility_conditions
If no eligible pair exists, return null.
Do not use fiscal year as a direct year lookup.
Do not use an observation whose annual period has not finished before cutoff.
cand_m3i_fx_change_official_annual.observation_year_selection_rule: Within the selected pre-cutoff WDI archive vintage, choose the maximum Gregorian observation year y such that E_y and E_(y-1) are both non-missing, positive, consecutive annual observations, December 31 of y is strictly earlier than the pair prediction cutoff, and both observations have the same verified currency denomination and valuation definition.

vintage_evidence_required_fields: release date and, if available, release time
series title or archived label compatible with the locked title
unit compatible with the locked unit
wdi_as_of_rules: Use the latest official WDI Database Archive release strictly before the pair cutoff.
Use only values contained in that archived release.
available_at is the verified release timestamp of that WDI edition.
A later archive edition is a new vintage and never overwrites an earlier vintage.
If exact time is unavailable but the release date is verified, available_at = 00:00:00 UTC on the next calendar day.
Therefore a date-only release on the same calendar date as the cutoff is excluded.
If no pre-cutoff vintage can be verified, the feature value is null.
No mapping based only on fiscal-year labels is allowed.
Jalali and Gregorian dates must remain separately preserved with provenance.
No current WDI value may be treated as historically available merely because its observation year precedes the cutoff.
